title: ExplainerNarrateInput
description: Arguments for explainer_narrate. Shape ported from the reference implementation, minus the session_name argument, which was its internal job-routing detail and is not part of this contract.

dry_run.description: Emit silence of a plausible length instead of calling the TTS server. Produces real timings.json and captions.json, so a composition can be built and checked before any speech is synthesised.
